g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Pages layer in the Electron app')
sendPrompt('What components would be in the library organizer UI?')
sendPrompt('How should state be managed in the Electron renderer?')
sendPrompt('How does the contextBridge IPC work in Electron?')
sendPrompt('What IPC handlers does the main process need for library-organizer?')
sendPrompt('How should the Electron main process spawn the CLI as a child process?')
sendPrompt('How do I open a folder picker dialog from Electron main process?')
sendPrompt('How should I bundle the Python CLI exe inside the Electron app?')
sendPrompt('What are all the modes of library-organizer?')
sendPrompt('What does the --progress-format json output look like?')
sendPrompt('How should the Electron app display JSON report files from library-organizer?')

svg.text: • contextBridge — no direct Node access from renderer (security)
• spawn() with --progress-format json — parse each stdout line as a progress event
• exe bundled in resources/ — resolve path with app.getAppPath() at runtime
